plugins.name: super-ralph
plugins.description: Design-first autonomous development workflow. /design produces implementation-ready epics with [STORY]/[BE]/[FE]/[INT] sub-issues. v0.11.0 adds --local mode (write entire plan to a single markdown file, skip GitHub) and /improve-design (single-prompt adjustments to existing designs). Fire-and-forget build → review → verify → release pipelines. Domain-aware repair with hotfix flow.

plugins.name: forth-ai-harness
plugins.description: Junhua's technical-cofounder-in-a-plugin for ForthAI Work — 11 slash commands (/fbrainstorm /fspec /fdesign /fbuild /fpolish /ftest /ffix /flaunch /fretro /fdream /fhelp) with Claude+Codex dual-AI collaboration via the --codex flag. Each command is a /loop-style convergence loop until both Junhua and the AI are 100% satisfied. /fdream is the recursive cofounder pass — the plugin reads its own memory and improves itself with semver-correct version bumps. Cross-task memory layer at .claude/forth-ai-harness-memory/. Linear is SSoT; artifacts are AI-readable markdown sized to fit one 1M-token context window.
